strings.en: Leave this to Shoko!
All right, here I come!
I can't leave everything/　to my big brother!
I won't let you do as you please!
Now!
Hm! Right where I want you!
Hold still right there!
Here's my chance!
The G-Thundergate will be your opponent!
I need to be Cautious...!
Watch the enemy's movements carefully...!
Here we go, G-Thundergate!
I'll fight as Fighter Emmy!
There!
I'll hit you, just watch!
The enemy's a new model. I can't be reckless!
Here I come, Jua-Mu!
Holding a grudge against Touya and the rest is wrong!
Just because it's a Raftclans,/　I can't flinch!
Princess Shana-Mia is thinking/　about the Fury's future, too!
Emperor unit, my foot! Shoko and the rest'll stop you!
Even if I asked,/　I doubt I'd get an answer...!
People who talk like that/　are often pretty cold, actually...!
Unless we get to Rabulpaila,/　this fight won't end...!
I won't let that man target Fairy and the others!
We can't let that man escape from here!
What are you going to do with captured Lamaris?!
I won't let you use any more weird spells!
I'll beat you in Roa's place, Debudedabide!
To save the Pilot, too...!
Just like That Time... What is that thing?!
Looks like it can control Zovorg weapons, too!
If it's that machine, I don't have to hold back!
It's a relief nobody's riding in it!
We won't have to pay for damages later... right?
If it's a Zovorg unit, it's all the same!
Controlling Zovorg units won't do you any good!
I won't lose, Crystal Dragoon!
Don't tell me you're from Kansai!
Stop coming to Shoko's world/　one after another!
Here I come, Skull Knight!
You won't get off with just broken bones!
Roa's ship has become an enemy...!
Annoying guests, as always!
You guys, learn your lesson already!
Stop causing trouble for Shoko's planet!
Quit messing with our planet!
Strong Zovorg robot, I won't lose to you!
I won't flinch, even against a battleship!
I can't abandon people who need help!
I won't lose, even to a new model!
Is that a new Zovorg robot...?!
Here I come, White Horn!
I have to slow Thorn down, even a little!
Your opponent isn't/　just the Soul Saber!
Is that something other than the Ruina?!
We have to do something before those overflow!
Disappear, Lamaris!
Shoko and the others will beat the Lamaris!
Please, don't split up!
Is the Ares Geist really/　drawing in the Lamaris?!
I have to help Arieil...!
I won't let you revive Dark Brain!
Here I come, Yokijin!
I can do yokai hunting too, just watch!
This is payback!
Make Shoko mad and you'll regret it!
I'm just getting started!
Now it's Shoko's turn!
I won't give up!
I'll catch up, just watch!
This is where I counterattack, right?
You're not getting away!
So you're aiming for Shoko!
Big Brother... Emi... I'm sorry!!
Th-The G-Thundergate!!
Kyaaah! Big Brother!!
Sh-Shoko hasn't lost yet!!
I can't believe all this damage...!!
Ah! I-I'm going down?!
Don't panic... I've gotta stay calm!
At this rate, I'll make big brother worry...!
So many warning lights...!
Get that conceited and you'll get hurt!
I-I couldn't follow that man's movements at all...!
We have to stop Gu-Landon... No matter what...!
A-Age difference has nothing to do with it...!
Using the Cross Gate like that...!
I need to be more careful...!/　Even the Compatible Kaiser got controlled...!
Debudedabide!/　Don't think you can keep laughing forever!
Getting slain by an evil dragon? No way!
J-Just you wait, Skull Knight!
So you'll never change your ways...!
Jeez! What was that for?!
Ngh! I've got to do this right!
I'm not about to go down/　in a place like this!
Ugh, I can't keep my balance...!
I can't make my big brother/　worry about me...!
How dare you hit me!
Geez, you keep aiming at Shoko's weak spots!
If we lose to the Emperor Unit, it'll be a disaster...!
If I lose in spirit, I can't beat that man...!
Am I being targeted because we're both red...?!
Herluga! Cut it out already!
Is that the end of the show?!
It's strong, just like Roa said...!
I won't let Skull Knight do as he pleases!
Ugh, stronger than Dark Brain...?!
If you're trying to control Shoko,/　it won't work!
Thorn is reading my evasion patterns?!
If you're trying to possess Shoko,/　I won't let you!
I knew they get stronger when they combine!
Owowow... I got hit.
This is nothing!
Ugh, I guessed wrong...
I'll dodge it next time, just watch!
The G-Thundergate's still okay!
Huh? I thought that would miss!
I'm still doing fine!
I have to read Al-Van's movements somehow!
Can't you think about all of us living together?!
We can't let them transfer Rabulpaila!
You'll pay for that, Debudedabide!
The Crystal Dragoon is targeting me...!
Don't get carried away, Skull Knight!
XN-L! This much is nothing!
It's dangerous unless I keep more distance...!
I knew I had to watch out for the Raftclans...!
Ow ow... Did that draw its attention at least a bit?
The barrage grazed me!
I didn't come here to play with ghosts!
Not by a flying jellyfish!
You can't hit me!
Too bad~!
Th-That was kinda close, huh?
As long as I keep moving, I'll be fine!
No dangerous people allowed!
There's no use targeting Shoko and the others!
If I watch out for the claw strikes, I should be fine...!
I won't give in to your power!
Don't underestimate me just because I'm a girl!
If you can't even beat Shoko,/　you'd better give up now!
You're trying to hit me with that scythe, I know!
Geez! Stop getting in Shoko's way!
Don't you understand the Cross Gate is dangerous?!
What's the big idea, Debudedabide?!
You missed, Crystal Dragoon!
Skull Knight! You can't catch Shoko!
Don't try to erase us just for your own convenience!
We can't let that thing get close!
It'd be bad to get hit by a battleship's attack!
Shoko has to be the decoy...!
I dodged Thorn's attack!
Ugh, that's creepy...!
You won't hit me, Lamaris!
The Lamaris Kaana won't catch me!
It's gotten faster, but I can handle that much!
Just give up on Earth already!
Shoko's not that easy to catch!
Can't have my big brother/　worrying about me!
Targeting Shoko won't get you anywhere!
Huh? That's all?
Th-That scared me~
My Guard is pretty solid!
That won't work on me!
Not so easily!
Huh?! I can't attack?!
No way... I was saving up, too...
Wh-Where'd it go?!
I lost sight of them...!
Leave the rest to Shoko!
I'm going again!
Here's a little bonus!
Shoko has to go here!
Support from the G-Thundergate!
Big brother, leave the rest to me!
Hey!/　We're not done yet, big brother!
Latune, I'll help!
Huh?! Arado, you're leaving already?!
Seolla, Shoko's got the rest!
Raul, I'll help you!
Ing, leave the rest to me!
Josh, I've got your back!
Rim, Shoko's got the rest!
Touma, I'll help you!
Michiru, Shoko's coming too!
Michiru, where are you going?!
Touya, leave the rest to Shoko!
I'll support Calvina...!
Akimi, I'll help!
I'll back you up, Akemi!
I won't let you!
I'll be your shield!
If I can just get in between...!
Shoko will protect you!
I'll protect you, big brother!
Big brother, look out!
Geez! You're such a handful!
Latune, get away!
Arado, what are you doing?!
Seolla, leave this to me!
Raul, please get away!
Ing, get away!
Josh, please fall back!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Get away, Touma!
Michiru, that's reckless!
Michiru, don't just tough it out!
Calvina, get away!
I won't let them get the Soul Saber!
Akemi, fall back while you can!
The Granteed's in danger...!
Let's keep it coming!
I can still keep going!
One more time!
This is our chance, right?
G-Missile, fire!
Thunder Smasher!/　I'm firing it, so there!
Thunder! Smasherrrr!!
Thunder Smasher!/　Go get 'em!!
G-Thundergate, GO!!
You're not getting away!
I'll finish this, just watch me!
Go! G-Thundergate!!
Gate Breaker!!
Finishing move! Gate Breaker!!
